info.title: pdf-signer API
info.description:
HTTP wrapper around the `pdf-signer` library: applies a visible signature stamp and a
PKCS#7/CMS detached cryptographic seal to a PDF in one call.

Only the local PKCS#12 signing path (Path A) is exposed over HTTP. The remote-HSM path
requires a caller-supplied signing callback and is available through the library only.

Authenticate with the `x-api-key` header on every `/api/v1` route.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Shared secret configured as the API_KEY environment variable on the server. Required on every /api/v1 route. Compared in constant time; a mismatch returns 401.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier. Branch on this rather than on the message text.

error.description: Human-readable description. Not stable — do not parse.
error.example: Invalid appearance: svgString must include a viewBox attribute

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, or "(body)" for a whole-body issue.

details.description: Present only on VALIDATION_ERROR: one entry per failed field.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by every non-2xx response.

error.example: PKCS#7 (17004 bytes) exceeds placeholder (16384 bytes). Set placeholderSizeBytes >= 17516.

actualBytes.description: Size of the assembled PKCS#7 container.

allocatedBytes.description: Size of the /Contents placeholder it did not fit into.

SignatureOverflowResponse.description: Returned when the certificate chain is larger than the allocated /Contents slot. Retry with metadata.placeholderSizeBytes set to actualBytes + 512 or higher.

signingDate.description: Signing time embedded in the PKCS#7 signedAttrs and the /M entry. Defaults to the server clock.

placeholderSizeBytes.description: Size of the /Contents slot in bytes. Raise this if signing fails with SIGNATURE_OVERFLOW. Rough guide: single certificate 3-4KB, three-certificate chain 10-14KB.

subFilter.description: Signature /SubFilter. Use ETSI.CAdES.detached for eIDAS/PAdES contexts.

svgString.description: A complete SVG document. MUST contain a viewBox attribute — the renderer requires it. Mutually exclusive with `text`.
svgString.example: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 80" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10,60 C40,10 80,10 120,60" stroke="#000" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

text.description: Text rendered in the bundled Great Vibes script font. Mutually exclusive with `svgString`.

color.description: CSS color for text mode. Default #1a1a2e. Ignored when svgString is used.

renderScale.description: Rasterisation scale factor relative to the stamp size. Default 2.

SignatureAppearance.description: Visual stamp definition. Provide exactly one of `svgString` or `text`.

x.description: Points from the LEFT page edge.

y.description: Points from the BOTTOM page edge — PDF origin is bottom-left, unlike browser canvas.

StampPosition.description: Stamp placement in PDF points (1/72 inch), bottom-left origin. Page sizes: A4 595.28x841.89, Letter 612x792, Legal 612x1008.

pdf.description: The PDF to sign. Rejected with 413 above the server MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit.

metadata.description: JSON-encoded SigningMetadata object, sent as a form field value.

appearance.description: JSON-encoded SignatureAppearance object, sent as a form field value.

position.description: JSON-encoded StampPosition object, sent as a form field value.

get.description: Unauthenticated. Use for container health checks and load-balancer probes.

post.summary: Sign a PDF with the server certificate
post.description:
Applies an optional visible stamp and then a PKCS#7/CMS detached signature, using the
PKCS#12 certificate configured on the server (P12_PATH / P12_PASSWORD). The stamp is
rendered *before* hashing, so the stamp pixels fall inside the signed ByteRange and any
later modification is detectable in Adobe Acrobat Reader.

Because the body is multipart/form-data, `metadata`, `appearance` and `position` are sent
as form field values containing JSON. `position` is required whenever `appearance` is
present; omit both to produce an invisible cryptographic-only signature.

schema.description: Hex SHA-256 of the concatenated ByteRange segments. Recompute it from the returned PDF and X-Byte-Range to verify the response independently.

X-Document-Hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the concatenated ByteRange segments. Recompute it from the returned PDF and X-Byte-Range to verify the response independently.

schema.description: JSON array [offset1, length1, offset2, length2] — the signed byte spans. The gap between them is the /Contents hex slot, which is not signed.

X-Byte-Range.description: JSON array [offset1, length1, offset2, length2] — the signed byte spans. The gap between them is the /Contents hex slot, which is not signed.

schema.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp embedded in the signature.

X-Signing-Time.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp embedded in the signature.

400.description: Bad request: no PDF part (MISSING_FILE), a field failed validation (VALIDATION_ERROR, with per-field `details`), the PDF could not be parsed (INVALID_PDF), the stamp was rejected (INVALID_APPEARANCE / INVALID_POSITION / MISSING_POSITION), or the signature did not fit the placeholder (SIGNATURE_OVERFLOW).

413.description: The uploaded PDF exceeds the server MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit (PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE).

500.description: Server-side failure: certificate could not be loaded (INVALID_CERTIFICATE), the ByteRange invariant failed (BYTE_RANGE_ERROR), or an unexpected error (INTERNAL_ERROR).
